text:
Alice (marketing): quick favor for runtime team — prepping webinar + launch blog and we need validated numbers for quantized variants. can you run a short smoke + targeted perf sweep (p50/p95/p99) for these configs and return raw logs + a small summary table? :pray:

Alice (marketing): target models & configs: open-13b:v2 (float16), open-13b:v2+q4_0, open-13b:v2+q4_k_m, open-13b:v2+int8. please include same prompt set and identical concurrency to be comparable.

Alice (marketing): sample payloads (approx):
```
1) short chat turn (~20 tokens user prompt, 60 token completion)
2) long instruction (~120 token prompt, 240 token completion)
3) embedding-style small text (~32 tokens) -- just to sanity-check embed costs
```

Alice (marketing): goals: 1) latency distribution (p50/p95/p99), 2) throughput at 4, 8, 16 concurrent streams, 3) token/sec cost estimate and GPU utilization, 4) any notable quality regressions (if you run the small QA prompts) so marketing doesn't accidentally claim better perf+same quality. need this by EOD Thu if feasible for slide prep.

Jin (eng-runtime): ACK, we can do a focused run. couple quick clarifying q's:
- which exact prompt set? "marketing-100" or full "eval-harness/smoke-1k"?
- do you want warm-cache runs (prefix warm-up) or cold-start only?

Alice (marketing): prefer marketing-100 (smaller) + appended 20 QA prompts from product. please include both cold-start and a warmed run (2 warm requests before measuring) — we care about live app behavior where prefix caching matters.

Jin (eng-runtime): perfect. will tag runs with `marketing/webinar/quant-smoke-1790123456`. rough plan: 1) deploy quantized variants to a dedicated test pool, 2) run 3 payload templates x concurrency grid, 3) collect latency percentiles, GPU mem/SM, and sample outputs for QA check.

Jin (eng-runtime): sample config I'll use (CLI):
```bash
redwood run-bench 
  --model open-13b:v2 
  --variants float16,q4_0,q4_k_m,int8 
  --prompts marketing-100+product-20 
  --concurrency 4,8,16 
  --warmup 2 
  --collect p50,p95,p99,token-per-sec,gpu-util,trace-id 
  --tag marketing/webinar/quant-smoke-1790123456
```

Sam R. (runtime): adding: please include full tracing header per request so we can map spikes to kernel choices. also set batch window to 8ms default, and capture one run with continuous batching disabled to show worst-case latency.

Alice (marketing): good call. also can you dump a small sample of completions for each variant (5 examples each) — we will run a quick QA pass and note any regressions.

Olivia (sales): FYI — if numbers look strong we may route inbound webinar leads to sales immediately. need a 1-paragraph blurb with the p95 numbers for the webinar deck by Fri morning.

Jin (eng-runtime): timeline: start runs tonight after 10pm PT (low noise), results posted by 10am PT tomorrow, summary table + raw logs uploaded to the bucket: s3://redwood-marketing/webinar/quant-smoke-1790123456.

deploy-bot: Job scheduled: run-id=job-84321, pool=test-quant, eta=2026-03-22T05:10:00Z

Sam R. (runtime): uploaded traces + small csv summary to the bucket; left notes in the run README about a tail-latency artifact on q4_k_m at concurrency=16 (KV cache eviction bump).

Jin (eng-runtime): final note — we'll also include a short appendix with methodology (warmup policy, batch window, hardware: A100-80GB, quantization backend used, seed for sampling). ping me if marketing needs different hardware or an expanded prompt set. :thumbsup:
